summary: PR 1035's tests pass unchanged on the prepared base and add no runtime correction. A real two-process Gloo fixture reproduces both reported unequal-row all-reduce contracts, while an added boundary proves SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=off leaves divergent speculative state unchanged. The existing DSpark synchronization remains a plausible mitigation, but no evidence identifies it as the cause of the two production sequences or justifies a further speculative source change.

tests.what_was_measured: The exact five candidate tests passed on the unmodified recorded base, proving the candidate is not failing-before/passing-after.
The retained candidate tests plus the explicit SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=off boundary passed; the GPU parameter exercised a device tensor on gfx950.

Expected failure: real two-process Gloo all-reduce with rank shapes (628,7168) and (1140,7168) reproduced the original 4,501,504 versus 8,171,520 numel contract and failed with a received-size mismatch/SIGABRT.

Expected failure: real two-process Gloo all-reduce with rank shapes (6098,7168) and (9682,7168) reproduced the original 43,710,464 versus 69,400,576 numel contract and failed with a received-size mismatch/SIGABRT.

gpu_execution.evidence: The retained CUDA-alike parameter ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with PyTorch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. It validates only same-device tensor overwrite behavior, not a multi-GPU collective.

remaining_limitations: The unequal-row contract was reproduced with two CPU Gloo ranks, not eight NVIDIA B300 ranks or NCCL 2.28.3.
Kimi-K3 and DSpark weights were unavailable, so the full multimodal chunked-prefill serving path was not executed.
No evidence connects either production collective sequence number to rank-local sampling rather than another scheduler, multimodal, batching, or sequence-length divergence.
The retained AST test covers one target-prefill call site and does not prove every DSpark or scheduler transition preserves identical TP batch membership.
SGLANG_SPEC_TP_SYNC=off intentionally disables speculative-decision broadcasts and provides no divergence detection.
No runtime source change was made because the available evidence does not justify one.
